intermediate_scope: Historical debugging runs with earlier rules; their metrics are not validation of the final source. Failed and interrupted runs are retained explicitly.
cycle_schema_note: Final runs include current pedestrian wait edges. Prior reports only detected car-car cycles; zero did not exclude car-pedestrian mutual waits.
seed7_scope: runs.7 freezes the current default seed7 initial world in stall-initial-default7.json. Earlier frozen seed7 phases use stall-initial-seed7.json. Distinct hashes are not paired comparisons.

passed: running clock and traffic are distinguished
stationary ego shows elapsed stop time
Planning excludes debugging waits and generator futures
delayed pre-pause poll cannot restore running state

known_root_causes.sleeping_pedestrian: Native Bullet test verifies setLinearVelocity alone does not wake a sleeping rigid body; setActive(True) precedes walking commands.

terminal_guard_case.attribution_note: Native object flag has no retained contact ID. R14 is the nearby physical barrier missed by the clipped guard; fixed guard detects it in this pre-contact frame.

local_car_pedestrian_yield.limitation: Offline geometry probe; native post-fix movement is evaluated in the final runs, not inferred from this point.

crossing_queue_extension.rejected_trial: 10s request-age priority reduced native throughput and was reverted; passing unit tests did not establish traffic quality.
crossing_queue_extension.final_change: Reserve only the current rear and remaining movement rather than the traversed entry-to-exit corridor.
